title: Retriever AI (Enterprise Cognitive RAG Platform)
description: Enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform featuring Hexagonal Architecture, pgvector hybrid search, local Ollama embeddings, RLM reasoning, and sub-100ms semantic response caching.
longDescription: Retriever AI is a production-grade RAG platform built using strict Hexagonal Architecture boundaries. It ingests multi-format documents (PDF, Markdown, text, OpenAPI), executing dense vector embeddings via local Ollama instances (nomic-embed-text) and sparse BM25 keyword indexing in pgvector. Features multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS isolation, streaming response synthesis with RLM reasoning loops, automated query rewriting, presigned citation downloads, and sub-100ms semantic response caching (⚡ Cached).
description_business: An enterprise document intelligence platform transforming static documents into interactive, citation-backed AI assistants with zero data leakage.
longDescription_business: Retriever AI enables organizations to turn static documents into secure, interactive knowledge assistants. Teams upload PDFs or operational documentation and ask complex natural-language questions, receiving streaming answers backed by verifiable source citations, granular multi-tenant isolation, real-time feedback loops, and semantic query caching for sub-100ms response times.
architectureHighlights: Strict Hexagonal Architecture decoupling domain core entities from FastAPI routers, pgvector storage adapters, and external LLM APIs
Hybrid Retrieval Pipeline combining dense Ollama embeddings (nomic-embed-text) and sparse BM25 keyword matching with score threshold re-ranking
Multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) isolation with encrypted tenant API keys, presigned citation downloads, and sub-100ms semantic response caching

challenges.challenge: High query latency, API rate-limit bottlenecks, and hallucinations across multi-document contextual searches
challenges.solution: Implemented an in-memory semantic response cache with automatic query rewriting, RLM context verification, and strict citation grounding in prompt templates.

challenges.challenge: Preventing cross-tenant data leakage while allowing flexible external LLM key usage
challenges.solution: Enforced strict tenant-scoped DB schema isolation combined with local-only embedding generation on Oracle VPS to prevent sensitive client data from hitting third-party API quotas.

title: Scoping Studio (Autonomous Client Discovery & SOW Compiler)
description: Interactive requirement modeling engine featuring dynamic cost calculations, transitive dependency trees, and instant commercial SOW PDF compilation.
longDescription: The Scoping Studio is a client discovery engine that models commercial software requirements into structured technical deliverables. It computes multi-variable quote pricing across base engines, feature modules, brand assets, and care plans, dynamically resolving transitive dependency graphs while compiling customized, print-ready Statement of Work (SOW) PDFs client-side.
description_business: An autonomous client discovery portal that translates high-level project goals into verified technical roadmaps, transparent pricing estimates, and downloadable SOW agreements.
longDescription_business: The Scoping Studio transforms the traditional friction of client proposals into an interactive discovery experience. Clients select their goal archetypes, customize feature capabilities, and instantly receive fully transparent pricing breakdowns with instant PDF proposals—reducing the sales scoping cycle from weeks to minutes.
architectureHighlights: Reactive commercial calculation engine dynamically computing engine tiers, add-ons, and maintenance schedules
Transitive dependency resolver ensuring prerequisites (e.g. database auth before subscription billing) are automatically activated
Client-side React-PDF compilation generating pixel-perfect, pinned-page-count commercial proposals and middleman agreements

challenges.challenge: Managing complex, multi-tiered feature dependencies without UI lag or invalid quote states
challenges.solution: Built a deterministic directed-acyclic dependency graph resolver that computes transitive closures in sub-millisecond timeframes.

challenges.challenge: Client-side PDF rendering performance and font-rendering inconsistencies across mobile/desktop browsers
challenges.solution: Architected custom canvas font loaders with pre-instantiated Google variable fonts and pinned page-count layout geometry.

title: Client Workspace & Lifecycle Control Plane
description: Closed-loop client mission control featuring PKCE OAuth, milestone tracking, automated 7-day trial tenant provisioning, and immutable baseline contract indexing.
longDescription: The Client Workspace is a secure operational portal where enterprise clients manage their project lifecycle. Built with Supabase Auth (PKCE) and session-gated API routes, it automatically provisions dedicated trial tenants on the Retriever platform upon authentication, locks initial SOW specifications as permanent baseline knowledge, and provides milestone tracking alongside Razorpay-integrated invoice ledgers.
description_business: A dedicated commercial client portal for tracking active project scopes, reviewing deliverables, and accessing dedicated AI copilot workspaces.
longDescription_business: The Client Workspace offers transparency and control for enterprise engagements. Clients log in securely to track sprint milestones, view verified architectural deliverables, process invoices, and interact with a dedicated AI copilot pre-grounded on their specific project contract.
architectureHighlights: PKCE OAuth session verification layer deriving client identities strictly from cryptographically verified tokens
Automated tenant provisioning bridge calling Retriever cognitive APIs to spin up client workspaces on initial login
Immutable contract indexing engine storing baseline SOW briefs as permanent, non-deletable grounding documents

challenges.challenge: Ensuring secure authentication and token persistence across Safari ITP and OAuth redirect fragments
challenges.solution: Architected a dual cookie + localStorage persistence adapter with server-side PKCE code exchange routes.

challenges.challenge: Preventing client scope tampering and cross-tenant data access
challenges.solution: Session-gated all REST endpoints with cryptographic token verification, guaranteeing queries are filtered solely by verified session email.

title: PrateekSync AI (Local Synchronizer & AST Architecture Engine)
description: Local Streamlit developer cockpit and AST architecture engine featuring zero-drift Supabase sync, Gemini multimodal AI scanning, and automated Obsidian canvas synchronization.
longDescription: PrateekSync is an internal developer control cockpit built with Streamlit, Python AST analyzers, and Google Gemini AI. It powers 14 modular hubs across content synchronization, client scoping, invoice ledgers, and outreach queues. Features atomic dual-write local JSON fallbacks with Supabase REST service-role synchronization, automated git hooks, and an AST-driven Architecture Knowledge Graph (`query_architecture.py`, `sync_graph_with_code.py`) that keeps Obsidian Canvas system models 100% synchronized with live code.
systemRole: SYS-04 // LOCAL CMS & AST ARCHITECTURE ENGINE
description_business: An internal operations and synchronization cockpit automating database governance, multi-channel client orders, and continuous architecture mapping.
longDescription_business: PrateekSync provides single-pane-of-glass operational governance for the entire digital portfolio. By automating database updates with local offline fallbacks, validating schema integrity, scanning incoming credentials with multimodal AI, and continuously synchronizing architectural dependency graphs, it guarantees zero-drift deployments and flawless platform reliability.
architectureHighlights: Modular Streamlit control cockpit with 14 specialized tabs managing clients, blogs, outreach, and analytics
AST-based Architecture Knowledge Graph engine analyzing cross-file blast radii and synchronizing Obsidian Canvas diagrams
Zero-drift dual-write pipeline coordinating atomic local JSON writes with Supabase REST service-role mutations

challenges.challenge: Preventing architectural documentation and visual diagrams from drifting out of sync with rapid codebase changes
challenges.solution: Engineered automated AST parsers (`sync_graph_with_code.py`) that regenerate Obsidian Canvas topologies directly from source code.

challenges.challenge: Maintaining zero-downtime database updates with local offline fallbacks
challenges.solution: Built atomic transaction writers with pre-commit validation routines that verify payloads before database writes.

keyDeliverables: Python AST Architecture Knowledge Graph & Canvas Sync
Zero-Drift Supabase / Local JSON Fallback Pipeline

title: Systems Terminal & Interactive Telemetry Console
description: Interactive in-browser diagnostic shell featuring live command execution, real-time git commit inspection, QR diagnostic matrix generation, and server telemetry.
longDescription: The Systems Terminal is an interactive in-browser diagnostic shell engineered with sub-millisecond command parsing, ANSI color formatting, and real-time observability tooling. It surfaces live Git commit histories, generates encrypted QR payloads for mobile verification, and allows visitors to run system telemetry diagnostics directly in a retro CRT green phosphor interface.
description_business: An interactive developer console showcasing system observability, server health checks, and live audit telemetry.
longDescription_business: The Systems Terminal demonstrates deep systems observability and developer tooling craftsmanship. Prospective clients and technical leaders can interactively execute audit commands, review real-time commit integrity, and inspect security telemetry directly from a lightweight web CLI.
architectureHighlights: In-browser shell interpreter with command history stack, auto-completion, and ANSI escape styling
Dynamic QR code encoding pipeline for secure mobile diagnostics payload verification
Real-time Git log integration streaming recent commit hashes and metadata directly to the terminal

challenges.challenge: Simulating a low-latency, authentic Unix terminal experience with smooth keystroke buffering in React
challenges.solution: Architected an asynchronous command dispatcher with a virtualized scroll buffer and accessible keyboard traps.

challenges.challenge: Rendering scannable diagnostic QR codes without external blocking network calls
challenges.solution: Implemented a local server-side QR SVG generator endpoint (/api/terminal/qrcode) with sub-10ms response times.
